rulings.item: divergence 1 (holds_wrongly) at t=0 ms: The heading is [-7,-1] and the carrier direction is [1,1], so their exact cosine is -8/sqrt(50·2) = -0.8. With cos_tol = 0.8 the strict comparison must fail, bu — contract: fails, body: holds; contract: "the cosine of the angle between its heading (kin.heading) and the carrier's designated direction (st.lane_direction), re"
rulings.why: The contract's normalised vectors are its two atoms, and each atom's contract defines its normalised reading as the unit vector times a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶. At an exact cosine of -0.8 that factor puts the dot product just below -0.8, so the body's verdict follows from a reasonable reading of the contract's words; it also turns only on cos_tol sitting exactly at the boundary, a value the caller sets. — "a formula reads it normalised: divided by its larger absolute component, then by its length taken to a micrometre, so the vector read is the unit vector times a"
